speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass. To better understand your situation, can you tell me how long ago you last had a menstrual period, and have you experienced any pain, fever, or urinary symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Cancer (pending histopathology confirmation).

I have noted your age and the specific symptoms of intermittent bleeding without systemic signs like fever or weight loss. Given the adnexal mass and postmenopausal bleeding, immediate imaging of the pelvis is required to characterize the mass. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound, CA125_Blood_Test.
